features.name: storage.grpc.plaintext
features.description: Storage gRPC API over cleartext HTTP/2 on the node's gRPC port.

features.name: storage.grpc.tls
features.description: Storage gRPC API over TLS with a self-signed certificate whose fingerprint the node key signs (StorageTlsProof v2); gateways pin it.

features.name: storage.rpc.auth.v1
features.description: Storage RPCs carry an EIP-191 node-identity token; the node accepts only registered network members.
